results.evidence: Second pass, still one spot-specific source. NEW: the official Region 6 list of sites where day-use fees are charged names, in the Stevens Pass/US 2 area, Wellington Trailhead and Iron Goat/Martin Creek Trailhead (plus Stevens South PCT TH) and nothing on Old Stevens Pass Highway/Tye Road itself; the Forest's own page for the road the crag parks on (Old Stevens Pass Highway, FS Road 6099, turnoff at US 2 MP 64.4) carries no fee section, while the Wellington Trailhead page (same turnoff, 2.8 mi down then FR 050) carries 'Fee Site and Info'. That is one author (USFS) - it supports 'no fee' at a 1.4-mi roadside pulloff but is a single source. Searched for a second: the crag's climbing-database page and its archived copies (2022-2026) have zero comments and say nothing about a pass; no CascadeClimbers/NWHikers thread, WTA page or trip report names this pulloff and a pass either way; the recreation-pass vendor listing is USFS-derived (not independent). Insufficient under the 2-source rule; no ops. Note for owner: the row already contradicts itself - access.notes says 'not a developed fee site' and access.parking_pass says 'no fee site identified' while passRequired says 'Recreation pass'; once a second source exists the op is passRequired 'Recreation pass' -> e.g. 'None at the roadside pulloff' on these five rows only.

Day 1 miles 7.3 (trailhead -> Goat Flats) is wrong, but no two independent sources state ONE trailhead-to-Goat-Flats figure from the FR 41/Tupso Pass trailhead. Stated outright: WTA Goat Flats page 4.5 mi of trail (after the road walk); a photographer/climber trip report 5 mi ('5 miles and 2000ft ... from the trailhead to Goat Flats'); a 2003 WTA trip report 4.75 mi ('Trailhead to Goat Flats, 4.75 miles'). Segment-only (summing would be computing): USFS Trail 641 2.5 + 2.3; willhiteweb and SummitPost 2.5 + 2.5; WTA Three Fingers, trailchick, hike2hike 2.5 + 2. Trailhead -> lookout one way: willhiteweb 8 mi; a 2018 WTA trip report 'Hiking: 7 miles one way'; a blog 'hike another seven miles'; SummitPost/Mountaineers/Abegg 16 mi round trip; USFS puts Tin Can Gap at 6.2 mi. No day field takes a trailhead->lookout one-way figure without computing (day 2 = Goat Flats -> lookout -> trailhead), so the 7-mi agreement cannot be used either. Per the rule, no op (and nulling day 1 alone is not allowed). Owner option unchanged: adopt 4.5 (WTA) for day 1 and the totalNote '~7.3 mi', and review day 2 (7.7 mi / '~7.5 miles back out').

No source states a one-way Foggy Dew trailhead -> Cooney Lake figure for the Merchants Basin line. Stated figures are for other lines or segments: WTA Cooney Lake 4.9 (Foggy Dew) + 2.7 (Martin Creek) + 0.2; Wenatchee Outdoors 5 mi to the junction then 3 via Martin Creek or via Merchants Basin to the pass, 16.25 mi round trip; a Gaia listing 7.0 mi one way via Martin Creek; USFS lists Trail 417 at 5.0 mi and Cooney Lake Trail 434 at 1.5 mi (segments); a 2002 WTA trip report puts the Cooney Lake junction at 5 mi with Merchants Basin a mile beyond; a Foggy Dew loop trip report (up North Fork to Cooney Lake, down via Merchants Basin) gives only a 16-mi loop total; hike2hike's '~8 miles' to Cooney Lake is from the Crater Creek side. Nothing to adopt under the 2-source rule; no op (and nulling day 1 alone is not allowed). Owner note: the row's own waypoints put Cooney Lake at distMi 8 and its approach says ~19 mi round trip, both inconsistent with day 1 = 6.2.
